findings.description: The Lambda environment embeds an AWS access key ID and secret access key directly in Terraform. These credentials can be exposed through source control, Terraform state, Lambda configuration access, or runtime environment inspection, enabling unauthorized AWS access if they are valid.

The function uses nodejs12.x, an end-of-life runtime that no longer receives security updates. Deploying an unsupported runtime leaves the function exposed to unpatched platform and dependency vulnerabilities.
